summary.business_type: B2B SaaS / Professional Service (Export Document Verification for Pakistani Exporters)
top_findings: Zero informational content / blog for top-of-funnel keywords
Schema markup incomplete: only Organization + WebPage; missing Service, FAQPage, HowTo, Review
6 of 7 public pages missing meta descriptions
Three.js + GSAP + Tailwind CDN loaded on all pages but only used on homepage
Thin content on secondary pages (all under 300 words)
quick_wins: Add meta descriptions to all 6 pages (15 min)
Add FAQPage schema to Home + Pricing + Contact (45 min)
Add HowTo schema for 'How it works' section (20 min)
Move Three.js/GSAP/Tailwind CDN to homepage only (30 min)
Add display=swap to Google Fonts URL (2 min)

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: Clean semantic HTML5 with proper lang and viewport
HTTPS enforced via HSTS (max-age=63072000)
Security headers: X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy, CSP, Permissions-Policy
Robots.txt correctly allows public pages, blocks /app/, /admin/, /reviewer/, /api/
Sitemap.xml exists with 7 public URLs
Skip-to-content link for accessibility
Preconnect hints for Google Fonts
No duplicate content or canonical issues detected

findings.title: No XML sitemap separation for public vs private sections
findings.description: Single sitemap.xml lists all public pages. App/admin/reviewer correctly noindexed via X-Robots-Tag but not excluded from sitemap structure.
findings.recommendation: Create separate sitemap for public pages only. Keep app/admin/reviewer out of sitemap entirely.

findings.title: CSP may block inline scripts
findings.description: CSP: script-src 'self' but pages use inline <script> blocks (GSAP animations, demo interactions).
findings.recommendation: Add 'unsafe-inline' to script-src OR move all inline scripts to external files.

findings.title: No crawl-delay in robots.txt
findings.description: No crawl-delay directive; could be aggressive for small server.
findings.recommendation: Add 'Crawl-delay: 10' for polite crawling.

findings.title: Missing security.txt
findings.description: No /.well-known/security.txt for vulnerability reporting.
findings.recommendation: Add security.txt with contact email.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Clear value proposition above fold with specific user benefit
Strong E-E-A-T: 'A person reviews every report before it reaches you' (Experience + Expertise)
Specific use case: Pakistani exporters, WhatsApp/email workflow, local payment methods
Concrete interactive demo: mismatch table with real field examples
Trust signals: named reviewer (A. Rehman), refund policy, pay-after-delivery model
Comprehensive legal pages: Terms, Privacy, Refund all detailed

findings.title: Zero informational content / blog
findings.description: No articles, guides, or resources for keywords like 'export documentation Pakistan', 'letter of credit discrepancies', 'bill of lading errors', 'customs clearance Pakistan', 'HS code lookup'.
findings.recommendation: Launch a content hub: /guides/, /blog/, or /resources/. Target 20+ high-intent keywords.

findings.title: Thin content on secondary pages
findings.description: Contact (180 words), Sample Report (220 words), Terms (280 words), Privacy (250 words), Refund (260 words). All under 300 words.
findings.recommendation: Expand each to 500+ words with FAQs, examples, local context.

findings.title: Pricing page lacks comparison table
findings.description: Three tiers but no feature comparison matrix. Users must scroll to compare.
findings.recommendation: Add sticky comparison table or accordion.

findings.title: No case studies / testimonials
findings.description: 'Reviewed by A. Rehman' is the only social proof. No logos, no customer quotes, no metrics.
findings.recommendation: Add 3-5 case studies with shipment volumes, time saved, error reduction %.

findings.title: Contact page WhatsApp number placeholder
findings.description: Shows 'coming at launch' — signals unfinished product.
findings.recommendation: Replace with real number or 'Join waitlist' CTA.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Homepage has optimized title, meta description, H1, 1200+ words
All pages have unique H1 matching page topic
Semantic HTML structure with proper heading hierarchy (mostly)
Internal linking via footer navigation

findings.title: 6 of 7 pages missing meta descriptions
findings.description: Only homepage has meta description. All others will use auto-generated snippets.
findings.recommendation: Add unique, compelling meta descriptions (150-160 chars) to all pages.

findings.title: Inconsistent title tag format
findings.description: Home: 'Cleared: export documents...' | Others: 'Page Title' only. No brand suffix.
findings.recommendation: Standardize: 'Page Title — Cleared' or 'Cleared — Page Title'.

findings.title: No internal linking from homepage to legal pages
findings.description: Footer links only. No contextual links from content.
findings.recommendation: Add 'See our Refund Policy' link in pricing section, 'Read Privacy Policy' in signup flow.

findings.title: Heading hierarchy skips on Sample Report
findings.description: Sample Report: H1 → H3 (no H2).
findings.recommendation: Ensure H1 → H2 → H3 hierarchy.

categories.name: Schema & Structured Data
what_works: Organization schema on Home, Pricing, Contact, Sample Report
WebPage schema on all 7 pages
Valid JSON-LD syntax, no validation errors

findings.title: No Service schema for core offering
findings.description: Primary offering not defined as structured data. Missing serviceType, offers, areaServed, provider.
findings.recommendation: Add Service schema with serviceType: 'Export Document Verification', offers (Per Shipment, Desk, Partners), areaServed: 'PK', provider: Organization.

findings.title: No FAQPage schema
findings.description: Zero FAQ structured data despite clear Q&A content in prose.
findings.recommendation: Add FAQPage to Home (6-8 Qs), Pricing (4-5 Qs), Contact (3-4 Qs).

findings.title: No HowTo schema for 4-step process
findings.description: 'How it works' 4-step process (Send → Check → Review → Pay) is perfect HowTo candidate.
findings.recommendation: Add HowTo with 4 steps, tool/supply for documents.

findings.title: Organization schema incomplete
findings.description: Missing logo, sameAs (only LinkedIn), contactPoint incomplete.
findings.recommendation: Add logo URL, Twitter/X, Facebook, email, phone to Organization schema.

findings.title: Legal pages missing Organization schema
findings.description: Terms, Privacy, Refund only have WebPage schema.
findings.recommendation: Add Organization schema to all pages for consistency.

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: Zero raster images — only SVG logo/favicon
Variable fonts (Bricolage Grotesque, Fraunces) reduce font weight
Preconnect hints for fonts.googleapis.com and fonts.gstatic.com
Minimal inline CSS (cleared.css only)

findings.title: Heavy JS libraries loaded globally but used only on homepage
findings.description: Three.js (~80KB), GSAP (~40KB), ScrollTrigger (~20KB), Tailwind CDN (~60KB) loaded on all 7 pages but only used on index.html.
findings.recommendation: Move Three.js/GSAP/ScrollTrigger/Tailwind CDN to homepage only. Other pages load only cleared.css + api.js.

findings.title: Tailwind CDN in production
findings.description: Full Tailwind JIT compiler runs in browser — heavy for production, CSP issues.
findings.recommendation: Build Tailwind locally via CLI; serve minified CSS. Remove CDN script.

findings.title: Inline scripts on every page
findings.description: GSAP animation init + demo interaction scripts inline on every page.
findings.recommendation: Move to external app.js (shared) and home.js (homepage-only); load conditionally.

findings.title: No resource hints for heavy libs
findings.description: No preload/prefetch for GSAP/Three.js on homepage.
findings.recommendation: Add <link rel='preload' as='script'> for GSAP/Three.js on home.

findings.title: Font-display not specified
findings.description: Google Fonts URL lacks &display=swap parameter.
findings.recommendation: Add &display=swap to font URL.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: llms.txt exists at root per llmstxt.org spec
robots.txt allows AI crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended)
Clear, factual content with specific verifiable claims (pricing, process, payment methods)
Expert review signal: 'Reviewed by A. Rehman (documentation officer)'
Structured data (Organization, WebPage) present for entity extraction
No marketing fluff — concrete, verifiable claims

findings.title: No expert quotes / citations
findings.description: Content lacks citable expert statements (+41% citation lift per research).
findings.recommendation: Add 2-3 expert quotes from documentation officers, freight forwarders, bankers.

findings.title: No statistics / data points
findings.description: No metrics: 'X% of shipments have errors', 'Y days saved', 'Z% faster clearance'.
findings.recommendation: Add industry stats (Pakistan customs error rates, LC rejection rates) with sources.

findings.title: llms.txt could be richer
findings.description: Current llms.txt minimal. Could link to all public pages + schema + key entities.
findings.recommendation: Expand llms.txt with all public URLs, primary entities, key facts.

findings.title: No speakable schema
findings.description: Voice/AI assistants could read key sections.
findings.recommendation: Add Speakable schema to homepage hero + How it works.

findings.title: Reviewer not marked as Person/Author
findings.description: 'Reviewed by A. Rehman' not marked as Person schema.
findings.recommendation: Add Person schema for reviewer; link via reviewedBy.

categories.name: Images
what_works: Zero raster images — no optimization needed
SVG logo scales perfectly
No alt text issues (no content images)

findings.title: No visual content strategy
findings.description: Pure text + tables. No diagrams, flowcharts, screenshots, or product photos.
findings.recommendation: Add: 1) Process flowchart (Send → Check → Review → Pay), 2) Sample report screenshot, 3) Dashboard preview for Desk plan.

findings.title: No Open Graph / Twitter Card images
findings.description: Social shares will have no image.
findings.recommendation: Create 1200x630 OG image for each page (or shared brand image).

findings.title: Logo SVG has no accessible name
findings.description: aria-hidden='true' — screen readers skip it entirely.
findings.recommendation: If logo conveys brand, add <title> inside SVG or visible text fallback.

items: Add meta descriptions to 6 pages (15 min)
Add Service schema (Home, Pricing) (30 min)
Add FAQPage schema (Home, Pricing, Contact) (45 min)
Add HowTo schema (Home 'How it works') (20 min)
Move Three.js/GSAP/Tailwind CDN to homepage only (30 min)
Build Tailwind locally; remove CDN (1 hr)
Fix CSP for inline scripts (1 hr)

phases.name: Phase 2: High-Impact Improvements
items: Launch content hub /guides/ with 5 pillar articles (10 hrs)
Expand thin pages to 500+ words each (3 hrs)
Add 3-5 case studies with metrics (5 hrs)
Add Review/AggregateRating schema (20 min)
Add BreadcrumbList schema to all pages (30 min)
Create OG/Twitter Card images (2 hrs)
Add display=swap to Google Fonts (2 min)
Standardize title tags (10 min)
Add contextual internal links (15 min)
Fix heading hierarchy on Sample Report (5 min)
Add security.txt (10 min)

phases.name: Phase 3: Content & Authority
items: Publish 10+ blog posts targeting export doc keywords (20 hrs)
Build topic clusters: LC terms, HS codes, Pakistan customs, B/L errors (15 hrs)
Add LocalBusiness schema (15 min)
Add Speakable schema (20 min)
Expand llms.txt with full entity catalog (30 min)
Backlink outreach: Pakistan trade associations, freight forums, customs brokers (ongoing)

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring & Iteration
items: Monitor GSC for indexing, search queries, CTR (weekly)
Track Core Web Vitals via CrUX (monthly)
Audit schema validity after each deploy (per deploy)
Update content for regulation changes (quarterly)
Competitor gap analysis (quarterly)
